Atlanta Dream to Host WNBA Finals Games in Larger Arena

The Atlanta Dream will host Games 3 and 4 of the WNBA Finals at State Farm Arena. This decision followed a period of "days-long drama" and involved scheduling changes. The team's progression to the Finals is attributed to "patience, trades and 1 bold bet."
